scene.ofreeRecent: a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor roller-skating rink during a quiet afternoon — celebrating a cautious first glide by offering a small wave and laughing softly at her own nervous confidence; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — chest-deep in the water; a Guan Yu temple — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small private sleeper-train cabin at dawn — savoring the first teaspoon of honey in a warm breakfast while the train passes misty fields; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — standing close to a high shelf or line; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — sitting on the ground; a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — seated on a chair
